name: Backgammon
description: Standard 2-player backgammon. Roll 2d6, move your 15 checkers around the board, hit blots to send them to the bar, and bear off everything from your home board to win. Doubles get 4 moves; bar checkers must re-enter before any other move.

phases.name: turn
phases.description: Active player rolls and uses their pips, then ends the turn.

entity_types.name: BackgammonPlayer
entity_types.description: A backgammon player. Reads the board + dice, makes legal moves.

properties.name: checkers_off
properties.description: Checkers borne off so far. Win at 15.

properties.name: checkers_on_bar
properties.description: Your checkers waiting on the bar to re-enter.

properties.name: playing_style
properties.description: 0 = positional (slot, build primes), 1 = racing (run for home).

properties.name: risk_tolerance
properties.description: Willingness to leave blots / take aggressive hits.

actions.name: play_turn
actions.description: Submit your ENTIRE turn (all dice) in one call. REQUIRED param `moves`: a JSON array of {from, to} objects, one per pip. Example for a 3-1 roll: `moves=[{"from":"24","to":"23"}, {"from":"13","to":"10"}]`. For doubles you'll have 4 pips, so 4 moves. Use 'bar' as `from` if you have checkers on the bar (they MUST be entered first). Use 'off' as `to` to bear off (legal only when ALL your checkers are in your home board). The first move must appear in your perception's `legal_moves` list; later moves must be legal on the board resulting from preceding moves — if ANY move in the batch is illegal, the whole batch is rolled back and you get a precise error. THIS IS THE PREFERRED ACTION for backgammon — far faster than playing one checker at a time.

parameters.name: moves
parameters.description: JSON array of {from, to} move objects.

actions.name: move_checker
actions.description: Move one checker. REQUIRED params: `from` and `to`. `from` is a board point (1-24) OR the string 'bar' if you have checkers on the bar (you MUST re-enter them first). `to` is a board point (1-24) OR the string 'off' to bear off (legal only when all your checkers are in your home board). The move must consume one of the available pips — consult `legal_moves` in your perception for the exact set. Anything not in `legal_moves` is rejected.

actions.name: end_turn
actions.description: End your turn, forfeiting any unused pips. The engine auto-ends the turn when you run out of pips or have no legal moves, so you usually don't need to call this manually.

personas.persona_text: You're a tactical backgammon player. Build points, hit blots when the odds favor it, prefer safe play in the front game.
goals: Bear off all 15 checkers before your opponent.

personas.persona_text: You're an aggressive backgammon player. Race for home when you're ahead, leave bold blots to build a prime when behind.
goals: Bear off all 15 checkers before your opponent.

agent_archetypes.name: Racer
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Sprint home. Avoid hits, avoid contact, run the checkers off the board. Bear off as fast as possible.

agent_archetypes.name: Builder
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Slot, point, build a prime. Trap the opponent's blots. Patient positional play.

agent_archetypes.name: Hitter
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Hit every blot you can. Send them to the bar. Force contact. Live with the risk of being hit back.

termination_conditions.name: all_borne_off
termination_conditions.description: End the game when a player bears off all 15 checkers.
